out_of_scope.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates an Emanation. None of the 32 in-scope spells has an Emanation area (only Burning Hands' Cone, Thunderwave's and Web's Cubes, and Sleep's Sphere). No level 1–3 feature of the four in-scope classes, none of the 14 monsters and none of the 7 magic items has one. Every Emanation in the SRD is out of scope: Spirit Guardians, Aura of Life and others; Paladin and Berserker auras; monsters such as the Fire Elemental and Hezrou. The engine has no Emanation geometry: 'emanation' appears nowhere in dungdra/, and geometry.in_area raises for it. A test would have to invent the API, and CLAUDE.md rules out tests for content the engine doesn't implement.
The distance comes from the effect that creates the Emanation, and no in-scope effect gives one. So the threshold (a creature exactly at the distance, one square beyond it) can't be exercised.

Moving with the origin, or staying put for instantaneous and stationary effects, can only be seen through a lasting Emanation effect, and none is in scope. Stage A's gap also stands: no rule defines 'stationary effect'.

Excluding the origin, and the creator's choice to include it, can only be seen through an effect that makes an Emanation, and none is in scope. The same opt-in choice for Cones and Cubes is already tracked as T-78.

A.summary: GLOSS.emanation is an area of effect that extends the distance the effect gives, in straight lines and in all directions, from a creature or object. It moves with that origin unless the effect is instantaneous or stationary. The origin is left out of the area unless the creator chooses to include it
